ModMetaData.name: Sarlacc — Native Habitat (local)
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
SARLACC_HABITAT_BUILD_1 — the sarlacc's native-habitat build, off `design/Jawa/worldbuilding/sarlacc_native_habitat_draft.md` (ACCEPTED whole, all forks RULED, 2026-09-12 owner sitting, §8).
THREE STAGES, ONE CREATURE: - Stage I — the swimmer (RSW_SarlaccSwimmer): a mobile sub-sand predator, modeled on Anomaly's Devourer per the owner's explicit direction (§8) — sub-sand approach, swallow-whole via the vanilla CompDevourer, its "digestion" re-themed in every message as the press wringing a drink, not eating. Cut-free counterplay retained (nothing new added that bypasses normal combat). - Stage II — the anchored (RSW_SarlaccAnchored): what a swimmer becomes when it roots. Fork 1: swimmers ROOT IN PLAY — a swimmer that runs out of its birth-water reserve, or finds a buried seep (RSW_DeepDesertSeep marker), anchors visibly on the map and stops being a pawn. It strikes rarely, at its own mouth, at whatever stands beside it (the doc's "tithe"). - Stage III — the cistern (RSW_SarlaccCistern) and its drained end-state, the throat (RSW_SarlaccThroat): a landmark-scale reservoir. Fork 5: the breach is the ONLY kill — no hit-point bar, no poison route, the deed is done in person by interacting with the reservoir wall. Breaching it runs the doc's §4.4 consequence order (flood messages, ecosystem-death messages, conversion to the drained throat) at v1 fidelity — see the item file for what is simplified here versus the full pocket-map dungeon interior, which is owed to `sarlacc_spec.md`'s separate (also not-yet-built) KCSG ladder and explicitly out of this doc's own stated scope (draft §0: "Does not touch... the KCSG/pocket-map build ladder").
SEVEN CHANGED-RETURN HEDIFFS (Fork 8, all seven ship): the wrung, salt-eyed, the stillness, the tithe, the bloom, pressed, taken-and-returned (draft §4.5). A pawn that survives being swallowed and regurgitated by a swimmer or an anchored mouth is granted one, occasionally two, picked by this build (dealt by context is owed once the pocket-map interior exists to distinguish "taken in the press" from "taken on the shore" — see item file).
TRIBAL STAGE LABELS (Fork 9): the tribes' own words for the four stages are DRAFT flavor text in this build — Seeker / Debtor / Collector / Paid, echoing the Sun-Debt's own theology ("the sun lends and the sand collects... we take back what was drawn") — and ship as description flavor only, pending the owner's yes per the ruling's own wording. The doc register (swimmer/anchored/cistern/throat) remains the defName/mechanism vocabulary regardless of the owner's call on the flavor names.
OWED, NOT IN THIS BUILD (see infrastructure/state/items/SARLACC_HABITAT_BUILD_1.md): world tile 2920 relocation off the Weeping Stones oasis; placing 2-4 cisterns in true deep desert; the full pocket-map dungeon interior (press/gallery/reservoir levels); DBH thirst-need integration for the breach flood (Fork 6: DBH thirst is confirmed live so this is a real wiring task, not a design question); real sprite art (every texPath here is a placeholder reuse of existing Anomaly/vanilla art, never magenta, always a real file); a RimUtinni-side patch making taken-and-returned sacred/unclean specifically to the Sun-Debt ideoligion (this mod only ships the generic RSW-tier hediff, per the naming-tier doctrine that faction-specific reactions are RimUtinni content, not RimStarWars).
Requires the Anomaly DLC (Devourer's body/render-tree/comp are reused by reference) — every def here that touches it is MayRequire-gated.
